Set a stylized cyberpunk city fragment at night against a deep navy sky, floating on a flat, uninterrupted pale-blue ground plane. Exclude roads, curbs, vegetation, and terrain detail. Establish a crowded center and an uneven, inward-facing ring of towers around it; keep the surrounding composition deliberately sparse and surreal, without a continuous street network. Let isolated buildings and oversized dark slabs define hard scene boundaries.

Use roughly twenty detached high-rise towers for this much looser ring, with broad empty blue gaps separating them and the center. Vary their heights, making most simple rectangular residential slabs with repetitive grids or bands of bright white-blue windows and dark rooftop mechanical boxes. Include several landmark skyscrapers: cyan-lit glass towers with vivid hot-pink geometric crowns; a tall tower edged in pink, enclosed by diagonal lattice braces and finished with antenna fins; and a few extremely tall, nearly black monolithic slabs along the outer edges, some leaning into or extending beyond the view.

Make the central neighborhood a dense, irregular cross of roughly a dozen connected mid-rise blocks, tightly packed around narrow alleys and small open courts. Combine dark brick, gray stucco, and muted red façades with projecting window bays, balconies, exterior stairs, awnings, rooftop sheds, vents, air-conditioning units, railings, and rows of small glowing windows. Fit the ground floors with compact storefronts, glass doors, illuminated display windows, and horizontal or vertical East Asian neon signs. Above one courtyard, beside an open concrete frame, suspend a chunky futuristic vehicle in red-orange.

deterministic_rule_draft.prompt:
Set a stylized cyberpunk city fragment at night against a deep navy sky, floating on a flat, uninterrupted pale-blue ground plane. Exclude roads, curbs, vegetation, and terrain detail. Establish a crowded center and an uneven, inward-facing ring of towers around it; keep the surrounding composition deliberately sparse and surreal, without a continuous street network. Let isolated buildings and oversized dark slabs define hard scene boundaries.

Use roughly twenty detached high-rise towers for this much looser ring, with broad empty blue gaps separating them and the center. Vary their heights, making most simple rectangular residential slabs with repetitive grids or bands of bright white-blue windows and dark rooftop mechanical boxes. Include several landmark skyscrapers: cyan-lit glass towers with vivid hot-pink geometric crowns; a tall tower edged in pink, enclosed by diagonal lattice braces and finished with antenna fins; and a few extremely tall, nearly black monolithic slabs along the outer edges, some leaning into or extending beyond the view.

Make the central neighborhood a dense, irregular cross of roughly a dozen connected mid-rise blocks, tightly packed around narrow alleys and small open courts. Combine dark brick, gray stucco, and muted red façades with projecting window bays, balconies, exterior stairs, awnings, rooftop sheds, vents, air-conditioning units, railings, and rows of small glowing windows. Fit the ground floors with compact storefronts, glass doors, illuminated display windows, and horizontal or vertical East Asian neon signs. Above one courtyard, beside an open concrete frame, suspend a chunky futuristic vehicle in red-orange.
